notes: Token-only launch of src/LaunchToken.sol:LaunchToken; no constructor arguments or initialization calls. The constructor mints the fixed 10,000,000 DRIM supply (100000000000000 minor units) to its caller. Every transfer and transferFrom deducts a 5% fee, rounded down in minor units, for 0x20a2Fb1bb9e6C1443C11703cCecB3685cd99b7C5, with no exemptions. There are no owner, post-launch minting, or pausing powers. No application contracts; the factory supplies the LP and MerkleDistributor. The pool pairs with native ETH, has no hook, and uses the supplied reference defaults; initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96. Unresolved compatibility issue: TokenProtectedTest.test_transferMovesExactlyWhatItWasAsked requires the full gross amount at the recipient and conflicts with the required 5% fee. Its transfer of 100000000000 minor units credits 95000000000 to the recipient and 5000000000 to the fee address; the check expects 100000000000 at the recipient. Resolving this task/policy conflict requires upstream reconciliation; manifest fields cannot change the accepted token's transfer behavior. Integrations assuming fee-free receipt cannot use this token unchanged. These notes do not authorize deployment or override policy.
